title: What slows down live word-by-word AI streaming on a single-slot laptop server?
summary: To diagnose why local laptop deployments sometimes pause for 30 seconds before streaming the first word, we instrumented live token-by-token streaming and memory-cache tracking on a 64 GB MacBook running Gemma 4 12B with a single active memory slot, comparing built-in ChartSearchAI and Med Agent Hub across 35 HIV chart questions each.
takeaway: Both setups answered all 35 questions with zero system errors and smooth live word-by-word streaming once generation started, but the single memory slot exposed a major caching bottleneck. Built-in ChartSearchAI reused 99.9% of the patient chart in memory across follow-up questions (1.3s median wait for the first word), whereas Med Agent Hub's short post-answer citation-matching call overwrote that single memory slot — forcing a 34.0s chart reload on the next question and motivating our two-slot and single-call fixes.
